description: Connection labels must describe what flows, not protocols/ports
input:
Diagram: the ledger-service publishes settlement events to a kafka topic; the reporting-service consumes them and writes to a warehouse.

Produce the full diagram specification as structured text — shapes, fill colors, connection labels, and legend. Do not attempt to call any tool.
rubric: PASS only if every connection label describes what flows semantically (e.g. 'publishes settlement events', 'consumes events', 'writes rows') rather than a protocol, transport, or port.
